custom_error_classes.description: Custom error classes (NotFoundError, ValidationError, etc.) thrown with unclassified messages
custom_error_classes.fix_strategy: Identify all custom error class definitions and update constructors to classify message parameters, or ensure callers classify messages before passing

fix_approach.phase_1: Fix RuntimeError factory functions in src/runtime/runtime-errors.ts (12 violations)
fix_approach.phase_2: Fix custom error class throw sites across services (33 violations)

safe_render_rule: All error messages must be classified through classifyOperatorError before being stored in Error objects or rendered to operators. Internal diagnostics separate from operator-facing messages.
